serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: It’s this time of the week. Quickly, empty your pockets. It’s been a busy day.
The way he said it and his smug face obviously mean that he wants me to ask what happened.
You: Fine, I will bite. What made it so busy?
Landlord: Oh well, if you really wanna know.
Landlord: Remember that family you saved not so long ago? Somehow they pulled through.
You: Really? I’m glad.
You: Wait, how did that make you so busy?
Landlord: Don’t ask unnecessary questions! Dumbass!
